template: trade_when(abs(group_zscore(ts_corr(multiply({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, sqrt(ts_mean(volume,20))), multiply({owners_decile_rank_long}, sqrt(ts_mean(volume,20))), 60), group_cartesian_product(sector, market_cap_quintile))) > 1.5, signed_power(group_zscore(ts_corr(multiply({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, sqrt(ts_mean(volume,20))), multiply({owners_decile_rank_long}, sqrt(ts_mean(volume,20))), 60), group_cartesian_product(sector, market_cap_quintile)), 2), 0)
idea: 采用成交量平方根加权计算相关性（高流动性时期权重更大），在行业与市值五分组交叉维度内进行中性化，通过二次幂变换放大极端值，仅保留交叉分组内极端偏离（|zscore|>1.5）的信号，剔除市值与行业双重结构性影响。
